SELECT k.k,count(*),sum(r.v) FROM snia_index_keys k JOIN snia_index_rows r ON k.k=r.k WHERE r.v>2.00 GROUP BY k.k ORDER BY k.k;
SELECT count(*),sum(r.v) FROM snia_index_keys k JOIN snia_index_rows r ON k.k=r.k WHERE r.v>2.00 OR k.k<0;
SELECT count(*),sum(r.v) FROM snia_index_big_keys k JOIN snia_index_big_rows r ON k.k=r.k;
